basic_info.description: Showcasing refined design, this Mission Dolores corner-lot home blends timeless elegance with modern functionality. Renovated down to the studs in 2016 by Malcolm Davis, this 4bd/3ba, 2,630 SF (per tax) residence features soaring ceilings, expansive windows, and premium finishes throughout. The upper level offers a dramatic skylit hallway, formal living/dining rooms, and an open-concept kitchen/family room with Wolf range, sleek Wolf, Sub-Zero and Miele built-in appliances, and walkout deck with direct rooftop access. The rooftop deck delivers sweeping downtown views - perfect for entertaining. The lower level hosts 3 spacious bedrooms, including a serene primary suite with private terrace, walk-in closet, and spa-like bath. Additional highlights: HRV recirculation air system, sound-proofed walls, automatic shades, formal laundry, and 1-car garage with interior access. Located 1 block from Valencia and 2 blocks from Dolores Park, steps to Lazy Bear, Tartine, Delfina, and BART/MUNI. Walk Score 98 - city living at its best.
